name: coding-agents
description: Explicit-only GUI Codex coding coordination with official subagents. Activate for a coding objective only through $coding-agents, explicit bundled-skill selection, or explicit use of the selected Coding Agents plugin; bare plugin attachment, generic subagent requests, and .coding-agents presence do not activate it.

interface.shortDescription: Explicit GUI coding with official subagents.
interface.longDescription: Coding Agents minimizes total coding wall-clock time by mapping dependencies and the critical path before the parent GUI Codex task dispatches work. Ready, independent, sufficiently large responsibilities whose benefit exceeds coordination and integration cost start in the same parallel wave without serial delay. Tightly coupled, dependency-blocked, overlapping, or too-small work stays parent-owned or ordered. The parent retains decomposition, authority, safety, worker routing, conflict resolution, integration, acceptance, and final reporting; each worker owns one exclusive complete output. State and verification remain minimal implementation support.
defaultPrompt: Use $coding-agents for this coding objective: map dependencies and the critical path, then parallelize ready independent work.
Use $coding-agents to minimize time-to-completion, not agent count; keep tightly coupled work parent-owned.
Continue the active $coding-agents workflow with parent integration, exclusive worker outputs, and minimal verification.
